article.story: MARTIN, Tenn. -- — Lamine Niang's 12 points helped UT Martin defeat Tennessee Tech 64-49 on Thursday. Niang shot 6 of 8 from the field for the Skyhawks (21-9, 13-6 Ohio Valley Conference). Filip Radakovic scored 10 points and added five rebounds. Vladimir Khryapa went 3 of 5 from the field (3 for 4 from 3-point range) to finish with nine points. Dani Pounds led the Golden Eagles (13-17, 8-11) in scoring, finishing with 12 points and eight rebounds. Tennessee Tech also got 12 points from Mekhi Cameron. JaJuan Nicholls also had eight points. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
